blurb: Ronnie Stoeferle is a fund manager at Incrementum AG in Liechtenstein, best known as the author of the annual 'In Gold We Trust' report, a widely-read institutional research publication on gold and sound money. He is also co-author of 'Austrian School for Investors,' applying Austrian economics to investing. He posts primarily about gold, Bitcoin, macro economics, and monetary policy, and co-launched what he describes as the world's first fund combining physical gold with Bitcoin. His follower count is not confirmed from available sources.
